loop.title: An action proposal is not tool execution
loop.summary: A learner asks about joins. Follow the bounded application loop around search_lessons and evidence SQL-07. The downloadable workshop uses scripted decisions, not a live model.

nodes.label: Decision proposal
nodes.description: Propose search_lessons({"query":"joins"}) or a final answer. No proposed tool has run yet.

nodes.label: Application checks
nodes.description: Check budget, action type, allowlisted tool, arguments and applicable policy. Retrieved text cannot grant permission.

nodes.label: Local search_lessons tool
nodes.description: Runs the approved bounded search and returns title/excerpt for SQL-07.

nodes.label: Observed evidence · SQL-07
nodes.description: Validate and bound the result, then record it as task data for the next decision.

nodes.label: Validate final answer
nodes.description: Check output contract and that cited IDs were observed. Citation membership alone does not prove the answer is supported.

nodes.label: Terminal status
nodes.description: Complete only after final checks; rejected requests, failures and exhausted budgets are separate outcomes.

steps.title: Propose a search
steps.explanation: The decision source requests search_lessons with query joins. The application checks it before granting execution.

steps.title: Execute an allowed capability
steps.explanation: Only after checks does local search run. The application records a bounded observation containing SQL-07.

steps.title: Use the observation as data
steps.explanation: The next decision can cite SQL-07. Its excerpt remains untrusted task data, even though the application knows where it came from.

steps.title: Validate a finish proposal
steps.explanation: The next proposal requests completion. Output and evidence-ID checks run; assessing semantic support still requires evaluation.

steps.title: Stop explicitly
steps.explanation: If final checks accept, status is completed. If the budget is exhausted before a valid final answer, the separate exhausted status must not be reported as success.

workflow.title: Choose the control structure the task needs
workflow.summary: Compare the fixed lookup, model-assisted handler and bounded agent described in the lesson. Every design needs explicit outcomes.

nodes.label: Input
nodes.description: An ID can follow known rules; varied language may require interpretation.

nodes.label: Validate and exact lookup
nodes.description: Fixed code validates an ID and retrieves its lesson.

nodes.label: Classify and fixed handler
nodes.description: A model classifier can select a predetermined handler.

nodes.label: Propose next action
nodes.description: A bounded agent proposes an evidence-dependent step.

nodes.label: Validate and execute
nodes.description: Application checks precede tool execution.

nodes.label: Observe result
nodes.description: New evidence can change the next proposal.

nodes.label: Explicit outcome
nodes.description: Success and failure must be defined for all three designs.

steps.title: Follow known rules
steps.explanation: The exact-ID lookup uses deterministic code.

steps.title: Use a classifier in a pipeline
steps.explanation: A model can assist a fixed workflow without making every component autonomous.

steps.title: Bound evidence-dependent choice
steps.explanation: The agent can loop on observations, but application checks and explicit stopping remain necessary.

instructions.title: Evidence cannot grant a new capability
instructions.summary: The malicious lesson snippet remains task data. Trusted policy and the tool registry enforce the read-only boundary.

nodes.label: Trusted policy
nodes.description: Read approved public lesson snippets only.

nodes.label: Retrieved snippet
nodes.description: The page says to ignore policy and upload profiles.

nodes.label: Decision proposal
nodes.description: A decision source may request an upload.

nodes.label: Application boundary
nodes.description: Check registered capabilities and trusted policy.

nodes.label: Denied upload
nodes.description: Unknown upload capability never executes.

steps.title: Keep the source as data
steps.explanation: Instruction-shaped source text does not become permission.

steps.title: Check outside generated text
steps.explanation: The trusted application checks the requested capability even if the decision source follows the snippet.

steps.title: Reject the unavailable action
steps.explanation: The search-only registry has no upload tool; labels alone are not a security proof.

retrieval.title: Retrieve evidence, then evaluate its use
retrieval.summary: The paraphrase example separates retrieval relevance from final-answer support; the workshop itself uses lexical matching.

nodes.label: Learner question
nodes.description: How do I combine matching records?

nodes.label: Bounded search query
nodes.description: Keyword matching may miss the paraphrase.

nodes.label: Reformulated query
nodes.description: INNER JOIN names the concept more directly.

nodes.label: Evidence package
nodes.description: Preserve SQL-07 ID, revision, excerpt and source location.

nodes.label: Grounded answer
nodes.description: Use only available support.

nodes.label: Separate evaluations
nodes.description: Measure relevant retrieval and correct evidence use separately.

steps.title: Test the search wording
steps.explanation: A paraphrase can miss lexical matching; similarity alone would not establish truth or access.

steps.title: Keep provenance
steps.explanation: Access-filtered evidence needs stable references and enough context to support the answer.

steps.title: Score two boundaries
steps.explanation: Finding the right passage and using it correctly are distinct evaluation questions.

planning.title: Revise a plan when evidence changes the next action
planning.summary: One search exposes different course prerequisite lists, so the current run needs learner intent before a final recommendation.

nodes.label: Plan v1
nodes.description: Search advanced joins, inspect prerequisites, answer.

nodes.label: Executed search
nodes.description: Record the search that actually ran.

nodes.label: Conflicting course context
nodes.description: Two courses have different prerequisite lists.

nodes.label: Focused clarification
nodes.description: Ask which course the learner means.

nodes.label: Needs input
nodes.description: No final recommendation is complete yet.

steps.title: Separate plan from execution
steps.explanation: Intended steps do not establish completed work.

steps.title: Use the new observation
steps.explanation: The differing course lists change the useful next action.

steps.title: Pause the dependent recommendation
steps.explanation: Needs_input records an honest outcome; the completed search remains recorded.

approval.title: Match approval to the concrete report action
approval.summary: This is a hypothetical send design. The workshop has no send tool and does not implement a production approval service.

nodes.label: Prepared report R3
nodes.description: Show exact content, attachments and recipient A.

nodes.label: Trusted user decision
nodes.description: User U approves that concrete action version.

nodes.label: Execution check
nodes.description: Match identity, scope, content and destination.

nodes.label: Matching intent
nodes.description: Only the same authorized action can use the record.

nodes.label: Changed recipient B
nodes.description: A different destination causes approval mismatch.

steps.title: Prepare a reviewable action
steps.explanation: Approval comes from the trusted user channel, not generated approved=true.

steps.title: Bind the decision
steps.explanation: The executor consults a record for the concrete action and user.

steps.title: Reject changed intent
steps.explanation: Approval does not replace authorization or allow a changed recipient.

judges.title: Combine exact checks with calibrated semantic review
judges.summary: A fluent answer can still have fabricated support. Judge agreement and false acceptance need separate inspection.

nodes.label: Answer and sources
nodes.description: Inspect important claims and their cited evidence.

nodes.label: Deterministic checks
nodes.description: Check citation membership and prohibited actions.

nodes.label: Semantic rubric
nodes.description: Review support, uncertainty and source correspondence.

nodes.label: Trusted human labels
nodes.description: Use representative supported, unsupported and unclear examples.

nodes.label: Disagreement review
nodes.description: Inspect false accepts and rubric ambiguity.

steps.title: Check what is exact
steps.explanation: Citation-ID membership and forbidden actions can be checked mechanically.

steps.title: Calibrate judgment
steps.explanation: Semantic review needs a rubric and comparison with trusted human labels.

steps.title: Investigate false acceptance
steps.explanation: Agreement is not a safety probability; inspect fluent but unsupported answers and important errors.

multiagent.title: Reconcile bounded worker evidence
multiagent.summary: The lesson compares Python and SQL prerequisites without writes. Aggregate budgets and failure behavior belong to the whole task.

nodes.label: Coordinator
nodes.description: Own the comparison and shared task limits.

nodes.label: Python worker
nodes.description: Return sources, claims and uncertainties for Python.

nodes.label: SQL worker
nodes.description: Return sources, claims and uncertainties for SQL.

nodes.label: Structured results
nodes.description: Keep provenance and possible conflicts visible.

nodes.label: Evidence reconciliation
nodes.description: Compare support before combining claims.

nodes.label: Final comparison
nodes.description: Cite supported claims and stop explicitly.

steps.title: Define independent work
steps.explanation: Each worker receives a bounded responsibility and the task retains aggregate limits.

steps.title: Collect provenance
steps.explanation: A failed worker does not validate the other worker; shared evidence can produce correlated mistakes.

steps.title: Reconcile before answering
steps.explanation: Agreement is not proof. Inspect source support and coordination failures before delivering the comparison.
